Hand-crafted fixture for ARX-CONSTRUCTS-364.

Covers `\label{sec:...}` paired with `\autoref{sec:...}`. The converter
generates an autoref-style numbered ref of form "Section <id>" via
src/arxiv_md/tex/transform/refs.py::_format_ref (kind="autoref", category=
"section"). For section labels, the section "number" slot currently holds the
heading text rather than a numeral, since no section counter is tracked at
label-build time — matching the existing behavior in _build_label_index.

What we lock in:
- `\autoref{sec:intro}` -> "Section Introduction"
- `\autoref{sec:methods}` -> "Section Methods"
- "Section " prefix is emitted (not raw `[key]` fallback), confirming the
  label index resolved both keys.
